content.text:
Your questions. Your data. Your code.

Openform is an MIT-licensed form builder with SQLite storage, seven question types, and a one-question-at-a-time experience.

The source is yours to run and change:
https://github.com/arjunkshah12345-hash/openform

media.altText: Openform launch film. Animated demonstrations of the editor, one-question-at-a-time forms, responses, CSV export, and MIT-licensed source.
